summary: Recent updates in the testing framework for Firefox enhance how the browser evaluates media performance. The addition of a test to measure the average frames per second (FPS) from MediaFormatReader’s debug information aims to ensure smoother video playback and a better viewing experience. Additionally, by avoiding Promise resolution inside the VideoFrame::CopyTo function, the browser is set to improve efficiency by reducing unnecessary complexity when handling video frames, which can positively impact overall media handling. **These changes help ensure that users enjoy higher-quality video streaming without interruptions or slowdowns.**
